title: GYROval: A Robust Benchmark for Cultural Value Orientation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a benchmark of binary contrastive scenarios based on the Inglehart-Welzel axes (sacred vs. secular and obedient vs. emancipative) to measure cultural value orientations via pole-share proportions across different thematic domains and decision modalities.
Administering a paired translation of identical evaluation items in English and Russian to measure systematic cross-lingual shifts in the models' expressed cultural value orientations.
Assessing option-order bias by counterbalancing option presentation order in binary choice scenarios to evaluate selection-share uniformity and choice conflict rates.
